paper_title: Automatic Evaluation of Attribution by Large Language Models
caption: Data source distribution of combined training and AttrEval-Simulation sets.
model_annotation: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of data sources in the AttrEval-Simulation set, showing the proportion of each source within the combined training and evaluation dataset. The chart is divided into five segments, each representing a different data source with corresponding percentages. The largest segment is ENTITYQUEST, accounting for 26.0% of the data, depicted in blue. The second largest is HOTPOTQA at 24.2%, shown in red. TRIVIAQA contributes 22.7%, represented in orange. POPQA makes up 21.6% of the data, shown in yellow. The smallest segment is TREC at 1.9%, colored green, and WEBQUESTIO accounts for 3.6%, shown in teal. Each segment is labeled with its respective data source and percentage, with lines connecting the labels to their corresponding slices. The slices are arranged in a clockwise direction starting from the top right, with the largest segments appearing first. The chart uses distinct colors for each category to clearly differentiate the data sources.
